reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The provision of a sovereign loan of up to EUR 66 million to the Republic of Serbia (the "Borrower"), represented by the Ministry of Finance ("MoF"), to finance the construction of a new impoundment dam and reservoir infrastructure at Pambukovica village in western Serbia (the "Project"). The proceeds of the loan will be used to finance the construction of a 27.5-meter-high earth embankment dam on the Ub River, designed to impound a reservoir with a total volume of approximately 8.15 million cubic meters. The Project will be implemented by the Public Water Management Company ("PWMC") Srbijavode (the "Client"), under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management ("MAFWM"). * Enhancement of flood protection and climate resilience in the Kolubara River Basin, one of Serbia's most flood-prone regions; * Contribute to the improvement of agricultural productivity and sustainable water resource management through the development of an irrigation network in Ub municipality; * Strengthening of institutional capacity in integrated water resource management through the establishment of a dedicated implementation unit within PWMC Srbijavode.
